checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are largely accurate. The 'Shoulder straps' checkpoint was correctly marked as false because the image depicts a full suit of plate armor with rigid pauldrons, not flexible straps. This is a stylistic variation rather than a defect in the breastplate itself. All other geometric and material checkpoints (curvature, ridge, polish, gilding) are correctly identified as present. The Router was not too lenient; it correctly distinguished between the specific taxonomy description and the visual reality of a full suit.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified text gibberish on the shield (severity 3.5), which is confirmed by the Image Text Auditor (confidence 0.51, nonsense text 'aePiuc'). The structural collapse on the left gauntlet (severity 2.5) is also valid; while the Topology Auditor gave a high mask confidence, this only confirms the object is segmented, not that the internal structure (fingers) is correct. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight compression, but the structural melting of the hand is a more significant generative artifact. The background perspective distortion (1.5) is minor but present. The Router did not underestimate severities; the text and hand artifacts are the primary defects.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'breastplate' (Rank 1, Logit 6.77). The visual features (curved steel, central ridge, gilded trim) perfectly match the taxonomy. The absence of 'straps' is due to the presence of pauldrons in a full suit context, which does not negate the correctness of the breastplate component. The alignment is near-perfect.
artifact_reasoning: Significant artifacts lower the score from perfect. 1) Text Gibberish: The shield contains illegible pseudo-text ('aePiuc'), a clear AI failure (Severity ~3.5). 2) Structural Melting: The left gauntlet/hand area lacks defined fingers and appears fused/melted (Severity ~2.5). 3) Minor background warping. These defects prevent a high artifact score, despite the high quality of the main breastplate rendering.
